notes: Tour got clearer on two things people asked about: why a share with no PN Edge still shows up in Strongest Today (it ranks proven evidence first, then falls back to score - a dash just means nothing's proven yet, not a data problem), and what the 5-vs-10-day hold setting actually means (it's testing an old backtest window, not changing how fast today's signals show up - 5 days is the one that matches how picks in this app actually retire).
